decision: Do not rely on Artifact Index producer commits for broad backfill until per-kind producer IAM scope is proven, or an approved coordinator/table format is selected.

repo_side_progress.policy_shape: The generated policy allows S3 GetObject/PutObject only for the configured Artifact Index kind's events, snapshots, latest pointer, and audit epoch paths under the configured artifact_root and optional proof roots.
repo_side_progress.provisioning_plan_shape: The generated provisioning plan binds one Artifact Index kind to one SSM parameter namespace, one per-kind IAM policy, explicit denied_artifact_kinds for proof probing, and the expected denied write attempt count.
repo_side_progress.runtime_secret_source: SSM parameter names only; no credential values are stored in repo artifacts.

backfill_safety_impact.remaining_risk: A broad producer credential can still write another artifact kind's event/snapshot/pointer paths, so producer ownership is not enforced by AWS yet.

next_required_evidence: Explicit approval for AWS security mutation if per-kind IAM is the selected path.
Provision one producer identity and SSM parameter set per top-level Artifact Index kind using the generated provisioning plan and policy.
Rerun artifact_index_commit_proof with denied_artifact_kinds configured so denied event, snapshot, and latest-pointer writes are rejected by permissions.
If per-kind IAM is not acceptable, select and prove an approved commit coordinator or table format before relying on Artifact Index commits.
